labs.title: Concurrent I/O with asyncio.gather
labs.goal: Run independent async tasks concurrently and collect results in order — the pattern behind concurrent DB/API calls in async services.
steps: Write an async fetch(name, delay) coroutine.
await asyncio.gather(...) three fetches with different delays.
Note that gather preserves argument order, not completion order.

labs.solution:
import asyncio

async def fetch(name: str, delay: float) -> str:
    await asyncio.sleep(delay)
    return name.upper()

async def main() -> None:
    results = await asyncio.gather(
        fetch("a", 0.03),
        fetch("b", 0.01),
        fetch("c", 0.02),
    )
    print(",".join(results))

asyncio.run(main())
